index 34d8bec..0b5be33 100644
--- a/qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml
+++ b/qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml
@@ -311,6 +311,18 @@ qt.workarounds.remove_service_workers:
     Note however that enabling this option *can lead to data loss* on some pages (as
     Service Worker data isn't persisted) and will negatively impact start-up time.
 
+qt.workarounds.locale:
+  type: Bool
+  default: false
+  backend: QtWebEngine
+  restart: true
+  desc: >-
+    Work around missing QtWebEngine locale files on Linux with QtWebEngine 5.15.3.
+
+    When enabled, use a Chromium-compatible fallback locale if the system locale
+    does not have a matching QtWebEngine locale file. This prevents network service
+    crashes and blank pages with affected locales.
+

+def _get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir: str, locale: str) -> str:
+    """Return the QtWebEngine resource file for a Chromium locale name."""
+    return os.path.join(locales_dir, locale.replace('_', '-') + '.pak')
+
+
+def _get_lang_override(
+        versions: version.WebEngineVersions, locale: str,
+) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Find a usable Chromium locale for the QtWebEngine 5.15.3 locale bug."""
+    if (not config.val.qt.workarounds.locale or not utils.is_linux or
+            versions.webengine != utils.VersionNumber(5, 15, 3)):
+        return None
+
+    locales_dir = os.path.join(
+        QLibraryInfo.location(QLibraryInfo.TranslationsPath),
+        'qtwebengine_locales')
+    locale = locale.replace('_', '-')
+    if os.path.isfile(_get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir, locale)):
+        return None
+
+    language = locale.split('-', maxsplit=1)[0]
+    if language == 'en':
+        alternative = ('en-US' if locale in ('en', 'en-LR', 'en-PH')
+                       else 'en-GB')
+    elif language == 'es':
+        alternative = 'es' if locale == 'es-ES' else 'es-419'
+    elif language == 'pt':
+        alternative = 'pt-BR' if locale in ('pt', 'pt-BR') else 'pt-PT'
+    elif language == 'zh':
+        alternative = ('zh-TW' if locale in ('zh-TW', 'zh-HK', 'zh-MO')
+                       else 'zh-CN')
+    else:
+        alternative = language
+
+    for candidate in (alternative, language, 'en-US'):
+        if os.path.isfile(_get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir, candidate)):
+            return candidate
+    # Even if the installation has no locale resources, Chromium's default is
+    # still the safest available override.
+    return 'en-US'
+
+

diff --git a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
index e7dbd5d..46fd485 100644
--- a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
+++ b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
@@ -28,6 +28,105 @@ from qutebrowser.utils import usertypes, version
 from helpers import testutils
 
 
+def test_get_locale_pak_path(tmp_path):
+    assert qtargs._get_locale_pak_path(str(tmp_path), 'es_MX') == str(
+        tmp_path / 'es-MX.pak')
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def locale_resources(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    locales_dir = tmp_path / 'qtwebengine_locales'
+    locales_dir.mkdir()
+
+    class LibraryInfo:
+        TranslationsPath = object()
+
+        @staticmethod
+        def location(path):
+            assert path is LibraryInfo.TranslationsPath
+            return str(tmp_path)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs, 'QLibraryInfo', LibraryInfo)
+    return locales_dir
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('locale, expected', [
+    ('en', 'en-US'), ('en-LR', 'en-US'), ('en-PH', 'en-US'),
+    ('en-GB', None), ('en-AU', 'en-GB'), ('en-CA', 'en-GB'),
+    ('en-IE', 'en-GB'), ('en-IN', 'en-GB'), ('en-NZ', 'en-GB'),
+    ('en-ZA', 'en-GB'), ('en-ZW', 'en-GB'),
+    ('es', None), ('es-ES', 'es'), ('es_MX', 'es-419'),
+    ('pt', 'pt-BR'), ('pt-BR', None), ('pt-PT', None),
+    ('pt-AO', 'pt-PT'),
+    ('zh', 'zh-CN'), ('zh-CN', None), ('zh-TW', None),
+    ('zh-HK', 'zh-TW'), ('zh-MO', 'zh-TW'), ('zh-SG', 'zh-CN'),
+    ('fr-CA', 'fr'), ('xx-YY', 'en-US'),
+])
+def test_get_lang_override(locale_resources, config_stub, monkeypatch,
+                           locale, expected):
+    for name in ('en-US', 'en-GB', 'es', 'es-419', 'pt-BR', 'pt-PT',
+                 'zh-CN', 'zh-TW', 'fr'):
+        (locale_resources / (name + '.pak')).touch()
+    config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.locale = True
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_linux', True)
+    versions = version.WebEngineVersions.from_pyqt('5.15.3')
+    assert qtargs._get_lang_override(versions, locale) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('enabled, linux, qt_version, expected', [
+    (False, True, '5.15.3', None),
+    (True, False, '5.15.3', None),
+    (True, True, '5.15.2', None),
+    (True, True, '5.15.4', None),
+    (True, True, '5.15.3', 'en-US'),
+])
+def test_get_lang_override_gate(locale_resources, config_stub, monkeypatch,
+                                enabled, linux, qt_version, expected):
+    (locale_resources / 'en-US.pak').touch()
+    config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.locale = enabled
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_linux', linux)
+    versions = version.WebEngineVersions.from_pyqt(qt_version)
+    assert qtargs._get_lang_override(versions, 'xx-YY') == expected
+
+
+def test_get_lang_override_missing_alternative(locale_resources, config_stub,
+                                               monkeypatch):
+    config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.locale = True
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_linux', True)
+    versions = version.WebEngineVersions.from_pyqt('5.15.3')
+    (locale_resources / 'es.pak').touch()
+    assert qtargs._get_lang_override(versions, 'es-MX') == 'es'
+    assert qtargs._get_lang_override(versions, 'zh-HK') == 'en-US'
+
+
+def test_get_lang_override_existing_locale(locale_resources, config_stub,
+                                           monkeypatch):
+    (locale_resources / 'fr-CA.pak').touch()
+    config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.locale = True
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_linux', True)
+    versions = version.WebEngineVersions.from_pyqt('5.15.3')
+    assert qtargs._get_lang_override(versions, 'fr-CA') is None
+
+
+def test_locale_argument(locale_resources, config_stub, version_patcher,
+                         monkeypatch, parser):
+    (locale_resources / 'en-US.pak').touch()
+    config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.locale = True
+    version_patcher('5.15.3')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_linux', True)
+
+    class SystemLocale:
+        @staticmethod
+        def name():
+            return 'xx_YY'
+
+    class FakeLocale:
+        system = staticmethod(lambda: SystemLocale())
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs, 'QLocale', FakeLocale)
+    assert '--lang=en-US' in qtargs.qt_args(parser.parse_args([]))
+
+
 @pytest.fixture
 def parser(mocker):
     """Fixture to provide an argparser.
